faq_item.name: Question
faq_item.default_question: How do I care for stoneware?
faq_item.default_answer: Wash by hand or on a gentle dishwasher cycle. Avoid sudden changes of temperature, such as moving a dish from the fridge straight into a hot oven, so the clay does not crack.

list_item.preset_2_text: A bisque firing, then a glaze firing that makes the stoneware dense and strong.
list_item.preset_3_text: Glazes are mixed and fired in small batches, so no two pieces are quite the same.

info.animations: Animations are always turned off for visitors who ask for reduced motion.
info.collection_card_image: Optional. Uses the collection image, or its first product's image.
info.corner_radius: Applies to buttons, inputs and cards.
info.heading_level: Use one H1 per page. The level is for screen readers and search engines; the size setting controls the look.
info.hero_color_scheme: Sets the text colors and the overlay color.
info.hero_height: Full screen fills the window below the header.
info.image_mobile: Shown below 750px. The main image is used when this is empty.
info.muted: Used for prices, captions and other secondary text. Keep a contrast of at least 4.5:1 with the background.
info.muted_text: Eyebrow text always uses the secondary text color.
info.overlay: Strength of the shade behind the content. It fades out towards the opposite side of the image.
info.section_alignment: Positions the content column and the blocks in it. Text alignment inside heading and text blocks is set on each block.
info.section_spacing: Space above and below each section from 750px wide; half of it on smaller screens.
info.single_open: Opening a question closes the others, in browsers that support it.
info.surface: Background behind images and image placeholders.
info.vertical_padding: Section spacing matches the space other sections use. Use a larger step when the section has its own background color.

faq_accordion.name: FAQ
faq_accordion.heading: Questions
faq_accordion.q1: How do I care for stoneware?
faq_accordion.a1: Wash by hand or on a gentle dishwasher cycle. Avoid sudden changes of temperature, such as moving a dish from the fridge straight into a hot oven, so the clay does not crack.
faq_accordion.a2: Orders leave the studio within three working days. You get an email with tracking as soon as yours is on its way.
faq_accordion.a3: Unused pieces can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Write to us with your order number and we send the return details.

feature_banner.name: Feature banner
feature_banner.heading: Made slowly, used every day
feature_banner.text: Every piece starts as a lump of clay on the wheel in our studio and ends on someone’s table. We keep the batches small, so we can look at each one before it leaves.

hero_banner.heading: Stoneware for slow mornings
hero_banner.text: Thrown, trimmed and glazed by hand in small batches, and made to be used every day.
